headword: {海外|かいがい}{在住|ざいじゅう}

definitions.explanation: The state or fact of residing in a foreign country. Used as a noun modifier (with の) or in compound expressions to describe people, experiences, or situations related to living outside one's home country.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}{在住|ざいじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of Japanese people living abroad is increasing.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}{在住|ざいじゅう}{歴|れき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{10年|じゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I have been living abroad for ten years.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}{在住|ざいじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感想|かんそう}→感想：00450_kansou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: We received many impressions from readers living abroad as well.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}{在住|ざいじゅう}{者|しゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき、{在外|ざいがい}⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: People living abroad can cast overseas ballots during elections.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧ (overseas) and ⟦{在住|ざいじゅう}→在住：12052_zaijuu⟧ (residing). Frequently used as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to describe people or services connected to living abroad. Common in administrative, media, and online contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海外|かいがい}{在住|ざいじゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧: Japanese people living abroad
- {海外|かいがい}{在住|ざいじゅう}{者|しゃ}: overseas resident
- {海外|かいがい}{在住|ざいじゅう}{歴|れき}: length of time living abroad
- {海外|かいがい}{在住|ざいじゅう}⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: experience of living abroad

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {在外|ざいがい}: being abroad — more formal, used in official/government contexts ({在外|ざいがい}{邦人|ほうじん}, {在外|ざいがい}{公館|こうかん})
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: life abroad — focuses on the lifestyle experience rather than the fact of residence
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{赴任|ふにん}→赴任：10601_funin⟧: overseas assignment — specifically for work-related transfers abroad
